correctness.rationale: Petersen vertices are 2-subsets of five labels, distance 1 iff disjoint and 2 iff intersecting and distinct. Within-block nonseparation is equivalent to all other blocks having the same neighbor-incidence bit; different blocks separate via coordinate zero. Restricted growth words uniquely enumerate all unlabeled partitions into k blocks. Independent from-scratch C++ enumeration at k=2,3,4 gave 0,0,7040 valid. For each of the 7040 canonical k4 states, checked all single-element moves to another nonempty class, yielding 34500 unordered edges. BFS from ALL 7040 vertices yielded eccentricity 7 for 6300 and 8 for 740, and 24777280 unordered distance pairs; connected, radius7 diameter8. Exhaustion of finite 10-vertex graph makes exact finite proof, not a sample or inference for larger graphs.
